response.original_title: The Feral Woman Who Lives in the Mountains
response.overview: After years of reporting on sightings of a feral woman who lives in the mountains, a news anchor falls in love with the subject of his story and ventures into the mountains to find her.
response.tagline: I vow to spend the rest of my days searching for, and, if she'll have me, marrying the Feral Woman Who Lives in the Mountains
response.title: The Feral Woman Who Lives in the Mountains
